# konnect_gateway_workspace (Data Source)

GatewayWorkspace DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "konnect_gateway_workspace" "my_gatewayworkspace" {
  control_plane_id = "cb4ca5b5-c0ad-4659-ac3b-9b4f1a9cb687"
  filter_name_eq   = "...my_filter_name_eq..."
}
```
